title: Colorado Revised Statutes, Title 10, Article 3, Part 11 - Unfair Competition - Deceptive Practices
verified_how: Expanded the official CRS Annotated table of contents: 'Title 10. Insurance (ss 10-1-101 - 10-23-110)' > 'Regulation of Insurance Companies (Arts. 3 - 3.5)' > 'Article 3. Regulation of Insurance Companies (Pts. 1 - 17)' > 'Part 11. Unfair Competition - Deceptive Practices (ss 10-3-1101 - 10-3-1119)', listed live among Parts 1-17.
notes: Part 11 contains both the unfair claim settlement practices regime and, at ss 10-3-1115 and 10-3-1116, the statutory cause of action for unreasonable delay or denial of a first-party benefit with two-times-covered-benefit damages - the provision most often litigated by policyholders.
